# Keys the dark Gruvbox Material Islands schemes must define explicitly (generated by tools/scheme/generate.py).
# Sources: Darcula and Default (DefaultColorSchemesManager.xml; Darcula has no parent, Default keys are
# written so they skip their code defaults), Islands Dark (themes/islands/IslandSchemeDark.xml), link
# targets, keys only code defines (a code default, or a code fallback chain onto a blue-allowed key),
# and every installed plugin file for Darcula or Default (additionalTextAttributes, or
# *Darcula*/*Default*.xml of a provider plugin):
#   DatabaseTools: colorSchemes/DatabaseDarcula.xml (Darcula)
#   DatabaseTools: colorSchemes/DatabaseDefault.xml (Default)
#   DatabaseTools: colorSchemes/SqlDarcula.xml (Darcula)
#   DatabaseTools: colorSchemes/SqlDefault.xml (Default)
#   Groovy: colorSchemes/GroovyDarcula.xml (Darcula)
#   Groovy: colorSchemes/GroovyDefault.xml (Default)
#   Kotlin: colorScheme/Darcula_Kotlin.xml (Darcula)
#   Kotlin: colorScheme/Default_Kotlin.xml (Default)
#   Scala: colorSchemes/ScalaDarcula.xml (Darcula)
#   Scala: colorSchemes/ScalaDefault.xml (Default)
#   angular-plugin: colorSchemes/Angular2Darcula.xml (Darcula)
#   bigdatatools-zeppelin: colorSchemes/NotebookEditorDarcula.xml (Darcula)
#   bigdatatools-zeppelin: colorSchemes/NotebookEditorDefault.xml (Default)
#   clouds-docker-impl: colorSchemes/DockerComposeDarcula.xml (Darcula)
#   clouds-docker-impl: colorSchemes/DockerComposeDefault.xml (Default)
#   clouds-kubernetes: colorSchemes/KubernetesDarcula.xml (Darcula)
#   clouds-kubernetes: colorSchemes/KubernetesDefault.xml (Default)
#   compose-ide-plugin: colorSchemes/IntelliJComposeColorSchemeDarcula.xml (Darcula)
#   compose-ide-plugin: colorSchemes/IntelliJComposeColorSchemeDefault.xml (Default)
#   cwm-plugin: colorSchemes/XmlDarcula.xml (Darcula)
#   cwm-plugin: colors/dark_attributes.xml (Darcula)
#   cwm-plugin: colors/light_attributes.xml (Default)
#   cwm-plugin: idea/FindViewColorsScheme.xml (Darcula)
#   cwm-plugin: idea/FindViewColorsScheme.xml (Default)
#   fullLine: colorSchemes/NextEditDarcula.xml (Darcula)
#   fullLine: colorSchemes/NextEditDefault.xml (Default)
#   gittoolbox: zielu/gittoolbox/colorschemes/GitToolBoxDarcula.xml (Darcula)
#   gittoolbox: zielu/gittoolbox/colorschemes/GitToolBoxDefault.xml (Default)
#   go-plugin: colorscheme/AsmIntelDarcula.xml (Darcula)
#   go-plugin: colorscheme/AsmIntelDefault.xml (Default)
#   go-plugin: colorscheme/GoDarcula.xml (Darcula)
#   go-plugin: colorscheme/GoDefault.xml (Default)
#   graphql: colorSchemes/GraphQLLanguageDarcula.xml (Darcula)
#   graphql: colorSchemes/GraphQLLanguageDefault.xml (Default)
#   grazie: colorSchemes/GrazieDarcula.xml (Darcula)
#   grazie: colorSchemes/GrazieDefault.xml (Default)
#   ignore: colorSchemes/IgnoreDarcula.xml (Darcula)
#   ignore: colorSchemes/IgnoreDefault.xml (Default)
#   intellij-csv-validator: misc/column_coloring_default.xml (Default)
#   intellij-csv-validator: misc/column_coloring_default_dark.xml (Darcula)
#   intellij-rainbow-brackets: colorSchemes/rainbow-color-default-darcula.xml (Darcula)
#   intellij-rainbow-brackets: colorSchemes/rainbow-color-default.xml (Default)
#   intellij-rust: org/rust/ide/colors/RustDarcula.xml (Darcula)
#   intellij-rust: org/rust/ide/colors/RustDarcula_legacy.xml (Darcula)
#   intellij-rust: org/rust/ide/colors/RustDefault.xml (Default)
#   intellij-rust: org/rust/ide/colors/RustDefault_legacy.xml (Default)
#   jade: colorScheme/JadeDarcula.xml (Darcula)
#   jade: colorScheme/JadeDefault.xml (Default)
#   javascript-plugin: colorSchemes/Darcula.xml (Darcula)
#   javascript-plugin: colorSchemes/Default.xml (Default)
#   jupyter-plugin: colorSchemes/JupyterDarcula.xml (Darcula)
#   jupyter-plugin: colorSchemes/JupyterDefault.xml (Default)
#   jupyter-plugin: colorSchemes/JupyterEditorDarcula.xml (Darcula)
#   jupyter-plugin: colorSchemes/JupyterEditorDefault.xml (Default)
#   markdown: colorSchemes/MarkdownDarcula.xml (Darcula)
#   markdown: colorSchemes/MarkdownDefault.xml (Default)
#   mermaid: colorSchemes/MermaidDarcula.xml (Darcula)
#   mermaid: colorSchemes/MermaidDefault.xml (Default)
